rationale: dashboard-print-layout.spec.js already covers print-mode entry via toolbar, exit via the close button, URL entry + reload persistence, single-table full-width, capture-readiness, and empty-dashboard cases. It does NOT cover the headline behavior of this fix: clearing printMode when the dashboard is left via browser Back so the globally-hidden app shell reappears. The new scenario fits naturally as one additional test() inside this already-registered spec (Dashboards-Core in ci_matrix.json), reusing its beforeEach/afterEach setup, teardown, and the pm.dashboardPrint page object. No new spec file, so no ci_matrix.json registration needed.
